salutation_opening.description: The opening words of the letter's body, as written

closing.description: The complimentary close above the signature, e.g. 'Your Loving Friend'

place_written.description: Where the letter was written, from the dateline

date_written.description: The dateline's date exactly as written, including any old-style numbering such as '25: 2: 1682'

messenger_described.description: How the letter describes the person carrying it, in the writer's words

promises.description: Each commitment the writer makes to the recipients, one short sentence each in modern spelling

delivery_note.description: The note written below the letter recording its delivery

date.description: Date given in the note, as written

illustration_caption.description: What the engraving above the letter depicts, in one sentence

printer_imprint.description: The lithographer's imprint printed small below the letter, as printed
